title: CommunityPostWriteRequest
description: community.post-write-request@1: bodies of the forum writes on OpenVibe.Community (community.post.create; a service writes as X-OV-Subject, or as AI with X-OV-Origin: ai). POST /api/v1/spaces/:space/threads: { title, body, members_only?, category?, attachments?, pastes? } (title 3 to 200 characters after whitespace is collapsed; body Markdown, non-blank, at most 40000 characters; body_markdown is accepted for body). POST …/threads/:slug/posts (a reply) and PUT /api/v1/posts/:id (an edit): { body, attachments?, pastes? }. POST …/threads/:slug/votes: { value: 1 | -1 | 0 }. DELETE /api/v1/posts/:id and DELETE /api/v1/spaces/:space/threads/:slug take no body. Unknown fields are ignored; refusals are problem+json (post.empty, post.too_long, thread.invalid_title, vote.invalid, thread.locked, vip.members_only, …).

members_only.description: A new thread only: true gates it to the author's own VIP members; { owner: usr_… } (or the subject itself) names the creator (moderators, or the author naming themselves); null or false: open.

category.description: A new thread only: the slug of one of the space's categories.

attachments.description: At most 4 images the writer uploaded (POST /api/v1/spaces/:space/attachments) and has not used yet, by media id. People only.

pastes.description: At most 4 shareable pastes (not private, not burn-after-read) by slug or /p/<slug> link: an array, or one string separated by spaces or commas.

value.description: A thread vote; 0 takes the vote back.
